package worker

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"sync/atomic"
)

// The runtime import is used by the host-only checkpoint substitution.
var _ = runtime.Gosched
var Stop atomic.Uint32

func Spin(started, finished chan struct{}) {
	fmt.Println("worker-entered")
	close(started)
again:
	if Stop.Load() == 0 {
		goto again
	}
	close(finished)
}
